issue.title: Task Card theme and relation-label stages may close the whole card on trusted Escape instead of backing out one layer

task_type_fields.impact: Pressing Esc in a Task Card sub-stage may discard the whole card session instead of returning to the previous stage. That breaks the one-layer-per-press Esc ladder and decisions:q-and-ctrl-bracket-mirror-esc in real Obsidian, while fake-DOM unit tests still pass.
task_type_fields.repro:
Proposed by bob-cli-om.10 (note #3, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP), triaged by bob-cli-om.land.

In real Obsidian, `Scope` is first-registered-wins and `Modal` binds Escape before the content element's keydown handlers run. om.10 found that this made trusted Escape close the whole Task Card instead of backing out the LINK band or recall. It fixed the prose/recall layer by routing it through `BulletPropertyPickerModal.onEscapeKey` and `pickerProseEscapeBackOut` (nav 2.101.0, commit fc806cfe).

Other Task Card stages still handle Escape as contentEl keydown branches that may never run before the modal closes:
- theme value stage: `plugins/bob-navigation-hotkeys/src/352-picker-task-card-theme-stage.js:967` (`this.stage === "value" && this.taskCardThemeStageRows && event.key === "Escape"`);
- relation-label stage: `plugins/bob-navigation-hotkeys/src/428-picker-relation-label-vocabulary.js:897`;
- relation stage handling in `426-picker-relation-stage.js`.

Repro to run: in real Obsidian with trusted CDP keys (the om.10 harness in `scripts/obsidian-prose-field-e2e.cjs`), open the Task Card, enter the theme value stage (or a relation-label stage), and press Escape. Expected: back out one layer to the previous stage. Suspected: the whole card closes. Unit tests that replay Obsidian 1.15 `Scope.handleKey` (added in fc806cfe) can pin the fix.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-om.10 proved that Obsidian's Modal Escape binding preempts contentEl Escape branches and fixed only the prose/recall layer; the same pattern remains in other Task Card stages and needs verifying and fixing.
